data.name: Nasheem
data.gender_notes: Nasheem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Nashara', meaning 'to deliver, save, or help'. In Islamic tradition, Nasheem is a name for those who are protectors and providers, and it is believed that those bearing this name will be guided by Allah to help and save others. The name Nasheem carries the meaning “Deliverer, Savior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasheem usually hope their child will grow to embody deliverer, savior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasheem total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
